method: spectral landmarks + independent centered log-spectrogram correlation
speed_limitation: Constant speed only; speed changes may be rejected. Segment speed is span ratio.
additional_audio_note: Unmatched duration includes cuts, narration, music and algorithm failures; cannot identify added sound from unmatched ratio alone.

residual_audio.method: 2-second mono 8kHz waveform samples; +/-180ms lag optimization; least-squares scalar fit; residual energy = 1-r^2
residual_audio.interpretation: Proxy for added/changed audio energy in aligned samples. Also includes codec, EQ, compression, speed/pitch changes and alignment error. NOT a music/effect time ratio. Cannot separate added sound classes.

confidence_definition: Centered log-spectrogram correlation; not a calibrated probability
